summary: M31 sprint validated end-to-end. Backend: new POST /tournaments/{tid}/budget/auto-split works — returns shape {created, skipped, created_count, skipped_count}, is idempotent (0 created / N skipped on rerun), 404s on missing tournament, 400s when input_variables or scheme_code missing. Created budgets are status=Draft, body_id set, total_ceiling_inr > 0, and are auto-linked to participants. Progress endpoint's squad_approved derivation now correctly reads submission_status from ALL squads-with-members — SM Khan Trophy (DIV-IND Approved) returns squad phase 2/2 · COMPLETE. Frontend: TournamentSubTabs shows exactly [overview, squad] — the 4 removed tabs (finance/claim/officials/camps) are absent. InputVariablesPanel action bar now has iv-auto-split-btn next to iv-save-btn (verified visible + clickable + gated on usesBackend). Clicking it confirms twice, POSTs to auto-split, alerts summary, and refreshes.
critical_code_review_comments: In tournament_workspace.py `_is_visitor_head`, the substring match uses ' da ' (spaces) which correctly avoids matching 'grounds', but keywords like 'food'/'stay' are matched without word boundaries — could theoretically match 'seafood' or 'stayover' labels. Low risk given curated rate cards, but consider regex word-boundary if head labels grow.

Auto-split endpoint acceptance_status filter includes both 'Accepted' AND 'Pending' — this may create budgets for participants who ultimately reject the invitation. Consider restricting to Accepted only, or documenting this behavior in the confirm dialog copy.

Fallback branch (line 229) creates a synthetic 'Team Travel Subsidy' head at 20% of ceiling when no visitor-keyword heads exist — silent 20% is a magic constant; should be pulled from rate card or config.
